_comment: THE SNOW LINE: y 500, wandering +-40 over ~1.5 km (user's pick from 400-650, 2026-10-31). Read by the biome router (peak biomes only above it), by snowfall (BiomeSnowLineMixin), by the alpine surface pass (snow pack, bare rock, glaciers) and by the tree and structure lines ([alpine] in terra_continental-common.toml), so all agree.
